actions.name: close_opportunity
actions.title: Close opportunity
actions.description: Record a win or loss outcome on an opportunity in Microsoft Dynamics 365
actions.help: Records a win or loss outcome on an open opportunity, based on Dynamics 365's WinOpportunity/LoseOpportunity actions.

input.name: opportunity_id
input.label: Opportunity ID
input.hint: Opportunity to close. Use the ID from a "Search objects" step on opportunity , or from id= in the record's URL.

input.name: outcome
input.label: Outcome
input.hint: Whether the opportunity was won or lost. Enter won or lost (case-insensitive). Actual revenue and close date are required when won; loss reason is required when lost.

input.name: status_code
input.label: Status code
input.hint: Status Reason value for the given outcome. Not a fixed set of values -- each Dynamics 365 organization can customize its own Status Reason options for the Won/Lost states on Opportunity. Use the "Get …

input.name: actual_revenue
input.label: Actual revenue
input.hint: Final deal value. Required for a Won outcome, not applicable for a Lost outcome.

input.name: close_date
input.label: Close date
input.hint: Date the deal closed. Required for a Won outcome, not applicable for a Lost outcome.

input.name: loss_reason_text
input.label: Loss reason
input.hint: Free-text explanation of the loss. Required for a Lost outcome, not applicable for a Won outcome.

actions.name: move_case_to_queue
actions.title: Move case to queue
actions.description: Move a case to a queue in Microsoft Dynamics 365
actions.help: Moves the case's existing queue item to the destination queue via AddToQueue. If the case has no queue item, one is created.

input.name: case_id
input.label: Case ID
input.hint: Case to move. Use the ID from a "Search objects" step on case , or from id= in the record's URL.

input.name: destination_queue_id
input.label: Destination queue ID
input.hint: ID of the target queue. Use "Search objects" with Object set to queue to find a queue's ID by its name.

input.name: source_queue_id
input.label: Source queue ID
input.hint: Current queue to move from. Auto-resolved when the case has exactly one queue item. Required when the case is in more than one queue. Use the ID from a "Search objects" step on queue .

output.name: action_taken
output.label: Action taken
output.hint: moved when the case's queue item now points at the destination queue; added when the case had no queue item; unchanged when the case was already on the destination queue.
